title: General Hwang Hsing

page_data.en:

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE (DETECTIVE BRANCH)）
Shanghai Municipal Council.
681
October 27th 1916

Sir,
The numbers of rebels dealt with under the repatriation scheme are as follows:-
Kiangsu, 90 groups, approximately 3000 men.
These men have received
$65,000.
Chekiang, 20 groups approximately 750 "
These have received $15,000
Hunan, 52 groups, approximately 1600 "
These have received $32,000
Hupeh 30 groups, approximately 1000 "
These have received $20,000
Anhui 60 groups, approximately 2000 "
These men have received
$40,000.
The above figures include several small groups and individuals from other provinces. The totals are 8,350 men among whom there was distributed $170,500.
A few of the groups are still unpaid and these will be dealt with on the 28th inst when the total amount distributed will be $172,000. A few of these men have left Shanghai but their places have more than filled by a few hundreds of rebels who participated in the Shantung trouble who were disbanded there and who have drifted to Shanghai.

Zih Koh Liang the Chief of Police has instructed his detectives to arrest anyone they find selling copper cash to the Japanese.
General Huang Hsing 黄兴 is reported to be suffering from lung and throat trouble. It is said that he has lost his voice completely.
General Lu visited the Arsenal on the 26th inst and discussed the proposed transfer of the 10th Division from Woosung. This transfer has been indefinitely postponed.
Notes of the French Banque Industrielle in Shanghai were being refused at some of the exchange shops in Hongkew on the evening of October 26th while others offered to take them at a discount of ten per cent.

Your Obedient Servant,
Captain Superintendent of Police.
C.D.I.

编号
（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处（侦探股））
上海公共租界工部局。
681
1916年10月27日

先生：

根据遣返计划处理的叛军人数如下：

江苏，90批，约3000人。
这些人已收到
65,000美元。
浙江，20批，约750人。
这些人已收到15,000美元。
湖南，52批，约1600人。
这些人已收到32,000美元。
湖北，30批，约1000人。
这些人已收到20,000美元。
安徽，60批，约2000人。
这些人已收到
40,000美元。

上述数字包括来自其他省份的几个小团体和个人。总计8,350人，共分发170,500美元。

仍有少数几批人员未获付款，这些人员将于本月28日处理，届时分发总额将达到172,000美元。其中少数人已离开上海，但其空缺已被数百名参与山东事变、在当地被解散后流落至上海的叛军所填补。

警察总监季科良（Zih Koh Liang，音译）已指示其侦探逮捕任何被发现向日本人出售铜元的人。

据报，黄兴将军正患肺部和咽喉疾病。据说他已完全失声。

卢将军于本月26日访问了兵工厂，讨论了将第十师从吴淞调离的提议。此次调动已被无限期推迟。

10月26日晚，虹口的一些兑换店拒绝接受法国东方汇理银行（Banque Industrielle）在上海发行的钞票，而另一些兑换店则愿意以九折接收。

您顺从的仆人，
警司队长。
C.D.I.
